description: Proxmox via Prometheus revision 5 combined with the project reviewed guest inventory, group budgets, usage trends and completeness checks. API instance filters the infrastructure section; Group filters the budget section. Budgets require the project noc_* recording rules and a reviewed single-cluster inventory.

targets.expr: sum by (job,instance,id) (pve_memory_usage_bytes{job="pve",instance="$instance",template!="1"} / pve_memory_size_bytes{job="pve",instance="$instance"} and on(job,instance,id) pve_guest_info{job="pve",instance="$instance"} and on(job,instance,id) pve_up{job="pve",instance="$instance"}==1)

panels.title: CPU history
panels.description: Busy CPU core equivalents (usage ratio × available CPUs), compared with available CPU capacity.
CPU utilization is already a 0–1 ratio from pve-exporter; display directly as a percentage.
panels.title: Current CPU

targets.expr: ((pve_cpu_usage_ratio{job="pve",instance="$instance"}) * on(job,instance,id) group_left(name, type) pve_guest_info{job="pve",instance="$instance"}) and on(job,instance,id) pve_up{job="pve",instance="$instance"} == 1

panels.title: Guests CPU usage
panels.description: CPU utilization is already a 0–1 ratio from pve-exporter; display directly as a percentage.

targets.expr: (pve_memory_usage_bytes{job="pve",instance="$instance"} / pve_memory_size_bytes{job="pve",instance="$instance"} * on(job,instance,id) group_left(name, type) pve_guest_info{job="pve",instance="$instance"}) and on(job,instance,id) pve_up{job="pve",instance="$instance"} == 1

(rate(pve_network_receive_bytes{job="pve",instance="$instance"}[5m]) * on(job,instance,id) group_left(name, type) pve_guest_info{job="pve",instance="$instance"}) and on(job,instance,id) pve_up{job="pve",instance="$instance"} == 1

(rate(pve_network_transmit_bytes{job="pve",instance="$instance"}[5m])* on(job,instance,id) group_left(name, type) pve_guest_info{job="pve",instance="$instance"}) and on(job,instance,id) pve_up{job="pve",instance="$instance"} == 1

((rate(pve_disk_write_bytes{job="pve",instance="$instance"}[5m]) + rate(pve_disk_read_bytes{job="pve",instance="$instance"}[5m])) * on(job,instance,id) group_left(name, type) pve_guest_info{job="pve",instance="$instance"}) and on(job,instance,id) pve_up{job="pve",instance="$instance"} == 1

panels.title: Group budgets, reviewed inventory and data quality
Proxmox scrape health
panels.description: 1=Up, 0=Failed; absent, duplicate or >=90s-old PVE scrape=Unknown. Exactly one job=pve target is supported. Success does not prove complete guest permissions or fresh underlying Proxmox host statistics.

targets.expr:
min(up{job="pve"})
  and on() (count(up{job="pve"}) == 1)
  and on() (time() - max(timestamp(up{job="pve"})) < 90)

panels.title: Guests missing resource metrics
panels.description: Reviewed guests missing any required CPU/memory metric, including suppressed ambiguous identities or invalid source/capacity. Nonzero requires reconciliation; no reviewed inventory is Unknown. Use the detail table below.

panels.title: Unmapped visible Smith guests
panels.description: Global count independent of group selection. Visible Smith guests without a mapping indicate a scoped/partial view. Unknown when the API source is invalid. Zero does not establish that a token can see every approved guest; reconcile the approved list.

panels.title: API CPU capacity / approved vCPU budget
panels.description: API-reported available guest CPU capacity, including stopped guests when the API reports it, divided by approved group vCPU budget. Reconcile maxcpu with the approved allocation policy; it is not a CPU reservation/quota. Missing/nonpositive/duplicate budgets produce no bar. Colors are display thresholds, not alerts.

panels.title: API memory capacity / approved budget
panels.description: API-reported guest memory capacity divided by the approved group memory budget. Missing guest metrics or missing/nonpositive/duplicate budgets produce no bar. Reconcile hypervisor capacity with approved accounting. Colors are display thresholds, not alerts.

panels.title: Reviewed disk allocation / approved budget
panels.description: Reviewed provisioned disk inventory divided by approved disk budget. Static inventory stays available during API outages; this is not physical storage consumption. Missing/nonpositive/duplicate budgets produce no bar. Colors at 80%/95% are display thresholds, not alerts; actual displayed percentages can exceed 100%.

panels.title: Group CPU: used equivalents, API capacity, budget
panels.description: CPU busy core equivalents, API available CPU capacity, and reviewed approved budget. API capacity must match the budget accounting policy before interpreting it as allocation. Lines are comparisons, not additive; null gaps are not connected.

panels.title: Group memory: used, API capacity, budget
panels.description: Separate group lines; quantities are comparisons, not additive. Null gaps are never connected.

panels.title: Reviewed group disk: allocated, budget
panels.description: Separate group lines; quantities are comparisons, not additive. Null gaps are never connected. Disk lines are reviewed inventory/reference values, not live physical disk consumption.

panels.title: Guest CPU / API CPU capacity
panels.description: Hypervisor-reported usage compared with API-reported available CPU capacity; reconcile with the approved CPU accounting policy.

panels.title: Guest memory / API memory capacity
panels.description: Hypervisor-reported usage compared with API-reported memory capacity. Reconcile with the approved memory accounting policy and compare like-for-like with Proxmox.

panels.title: Resource inventory
panels.description: Reviewed inventory; not automatic discovery or live running state. Verify all in-scope guests, including stopped guests.

panels.title: Groups with missing/invalid budgets
panels.description: Selected inventoried groups without exactly one positive CPU, RAM and disk budget. Zero excludes no failures within that inventory; no inventory is Unknown. An approved group without guest inventory still needs scope review.

targets.expr:
count(count by(group) (noc_guest_info{group=~"$group"})
  unless on(group) ((noc_group_cpu_budget_cores > 0 and on(group) (count by(group) (noc_group_cpu_budget_cores) == 1))
    and on(group) (noc_group_memory_budget_bytes > 0 and on(group) (count by(group) (noc_group_memory_budget_bytes) == 1))
    and on(group) (noc_group_disk_budget_bytes > 0 and on(group) (count by(group) (noc_group_disk_budget_bytes) == 1))))
  or (0 * count(noc_guest_info{group=~"$group"}))

panels.title: Duplicate guest IDs
panels.description: Global count of IDs duplicated in API guest identity, reviewed ownership or disk inventory. Resolve duplicates before accepting totals; source joins suppress ambiguous live data.

targets.expr:
count((count by(id) (pve_guest_info{job="pve"}) > 1)
  or (count by(id) (noc_guest_info) > 1)
  or (count by(id) (noc_guest_disk_allocated_bytes) > 1)) or (0 * count(noc_guest_info))

panels.title: Guests missing resource metrics
panels.description: Reviewed guests lacking one or more required current CPU/RAM metrics. Includes source outages and ambiguous identities. Empty table has meaning only with valid source, complete reviewed inventory, and healthy rules.

targets.expr:
noc_guest_info{group=~"$group"} unless on(id) (noc_guest_cpu_allocated_cores
    and on(id) noc_guest_cpu_used_cores
    and on(id) noc_guest_memory_allocated_bytes
    and on(id) noc_guest_memory_used_bytes)

panels.title: Unmapped visible Smith guests
panels.description: Global API-visible non-template Smith guests outside the reviewed mapping. Empty table does not prove full permissions or complete cluster coverage.

panels.title: Duplicate guest identity details
panels.description: Global list of ambiguous IDs and observed series counts. Reconcile source targets, API identity, ownership and disk inventory using the guide.
